newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Wal-Mart Brasil to lay off 300 workers - report.
newsitem.headline: Wal-Mart Brasil to lay off 300 workers - report.

text.p: Wal-Mart Brazil, part of Wal-Mart Stores Inc, will lay off 300 of its 2,500 workers, private Invest News agency said.
Officials at Wal-Mart Brasil could not immediately be reached for comment.
The decision was taken as part of operational changes, Invest News said.
Wal-Mart first opened in Brazil in 1994, and has invested a total of 118 milion reais since then. In the first half of last year, the operation lost around 16 million reais, Invest News said.
While not releasing figures for the second half of 1996, the company said it was still keen to invest in Brazil, seen as an important member of its list of priorities.
This year four hypermarkets are scheduled to be opened, representing an investment of 100 million reais, Invest News said.
-- Caroline Bulloch, Rio de Janeiro newsroom, 5521 5074151
